body.para: 1. Use the ATC–spindle gap tool to verify the clearance between the ATC arm and spindle.
2. Adjust the clearance by repositioning the ATC unit using the ATC push‑pull block.
3. Verify the ATC tool change position.
4. Install the tool magazine level pad; adjust the bolt to achieve contact.
5. Tighten the nut below ATC with Hand tight is sufficient. No specific torque required.
